lines: The flu virus goes into your body.
It goes in through your mouth and nose.
You should stay at home and rest in bed.
Drink lots of water and take medicine.
You can wash your hands often.
Get a flu vaccine before winter comes.
body.text: Sick people cough or sneeze. The flu virus goes into your body. It goes in through your mouth and nose. You feel tired and weak. Your muscles hurt. You have chills. You should stay at home and rest in bed. Drink lots of water and take medicine. You can wash your hands often. Get a flu vaccine before winter comes.
